injection.split: equal over the target class's nodes trading at the round's opening

criteria.detail: Holds on all 150 runs: the claim total the module tracks equals holdings plus parked at the end to within 1e-09 of the stock; every run recorded rounds 50 to 299; no node outside the target class's nodes trading at a round's opening moved in that round; each of those received the round's amount divided by their number, and a round's landings add up to its amount, both to within 1e-09; a round with none of them added nothing and is recorded empty (0 such rounds, 0 runs in which nothing landed).
criteria.name: A41-10  every injected amount is booked into the claim total and lands, split equally, on the target class's nodes still trading
